name: github-pr-review-fix
description: Fast GitHub PR review with optional conservative local fixes.

interface.shortDescription: Review linked PRs and apply safe fixes.
interface.longDescription: Runs a fast PR-first GitHub review workflow with goal-based task names, portable repository discovery, focused first-pass findings, optional deeper review, and conservative local fixes only when explicitly requested or clearly accepted.
defaultPrompt: Use $github-pr-review-fix to review these PRs. Findings first; no edits unless I ask:
Use $github-pr-review-fix to review and safely fix these PRs:
